claim: Multi-agent deliberation, where agents challenge assumptions and introduce complementary evidence, improves evaluation quality by producing ratings that integrate multiple expert perspectives.
falsifier: Replicate the multi-agent system with the described deliberation protocol and compare the final ratings against those produced by a version without deliberation, measuring rating convergence and evidence integration.

conditions: agents are equipped with retrieval-augmented generation and real-time search tools
deliberation is structured around established evaluation criteria
exclusions: limited to the reported system architecture, product concept evaluation task, and experimental conditions

title: Multi-agent deliberation process–evaluation quality mechanism

claim: Idea tree search and tournament selection improve the relevance and clarity of generated scientific ideas in a multi-agent AI scientist framework.
falsifier: Implement a multi-agent system with idea tree search and tournament selection for idea generation, and measure relevance and clarity scores compared to a baseline without these mechanisms, using the same evaluation protocol.

conditions: The system includes a researcher agent for idea generation and an engineer agent for experiment execution
The system uses persistent memory modules for ideation and experimentation
Evaluation is performed via automatic and human assessment on novelty, feasibility, relevance, and clarity
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported EvoScientist system, its specific agent architecture, and the evaluated scientific idea generation tasks; transfer beyond these conditions is unestablished.

title: Idea tree search for relevance and clarity
